description: Trano is a Python package published by the andoludo repository for generating Modelica building-energy models from YAML, JSON or RDF descriptions. It represents the building envelope, HVAC components and electrical systems, including hydronic distribution, boilers, photovoltaic generation and loads. The repository describes detailed-library support for Buildings and IDEAS and reduced-order options involving AixLib or ISO 13790. It also produces graphical representations of components and their connections. Public source and linked documentation are available free under LGPL-3.0. Coverage follows the user's building description; spatial detail, weather and simulation period are not fixed by the generator. The README describes optimisation for OpenModelica and compatibility with Dymola, but these claims were not tested here. A further caveat is that model generation still requires appropriate input data and a supported target library; an intermediate representation is not itself a calibrated building. Trano helps automate building-model preparation and scenario changes. It relates directly to the catalogue's Modelica Buildings library (model-modelica-buildings-library) and OpenModelica platform (platform-openmodelica).
name: Trano building-energy model generator
